question: Meeta starts walking from her office and goes 60 m towards the east. She then takes a right turn and walks 40 m. She then turns left and walks 36 m. She then takes a final left turn and walks 40 m to reach a park. In which direction is the park with reference to Meeta's office? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
As per the given information, the movement of Meeta is shown in the figure below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78286f9f34ff97793bfd996e8bba7469ceebd6c9b406f9f5ebe8f9cb2caac0c8.png] 

So, the park lies to the east of Meeta's office.

Hence, the correct answer is **"East".**
